name: IN JI
title: Backend Engineer

skill_groups.name: Infrastructure
items: AWS (EC2, ECS, RDS, S3, ECR, Route53, Lambda, SQS, Secrets Manager, CloudFront)

intro: **I enjoy simplifying repetitive work and improving the systems behind running services.** When building a feature, I consider how people will use it and what it will take to operate it day to day.

Seeing operations staff repeatedly rely on developers or connect to servers to complete routine tasks led me to build internal web tools they could use themselves. **Changing how work gets done through software** was rewarding, and it made me look for ways to remove manual work whenever I encountered it.

Expanding services across countries and migrating existing APIs taught me to look beyond the code being changed to the features and operations that depend on it. I am particularly interested in **making meaningful structural changes while keeping existing services running**.

With re:feel, an app I co-planned with a friend, I also built and operated a product myself. I developed the app and backend, handled deployment, and used usage data and feedback to refine its target audience and features after launch. I enjoy seeing how people use a product and turning their responses into the next improvement.

I now use MCP to bring product specifications and related code into context, and work with AI on implementation plans to speed up development. I review generated code myself and base architecture and technology decisions on the needs of the service and its operating environment.

companies.name: smaxh
companies.description: Tennis matching, lessons, and community platform. Backend development and operations for services in Korea, the US, and Australia.
highlights: **Python · Django · MySQL backend for match and lesson payments and settlement.** Built payment, cancellation, refund, and withdrawal flows. Supported a service whose monthly payment volume grew from **KRW 200M to 400M**, and transaction count from **16K to 30K**, between August and October 2025.

**Owned end-to-end COOCON integration for SMAXH Pay balance withdrawals.** Configured Terraform-managed infrastructure, S3-hosted environment settings, and Secrets Manager. Developed and deployed APIs for account registration and lookup, balance withdrawals, and transaction history.
**Partial refunds and settlement for no-show deposits.** Contributed to deposit payment, partial-refund, and settlement functionality; the deposit configuration rate was **78% in September 2026**.

**Web authentication compatible with the existing mobile app.** Integrated Google, Apple, and Kakao web login with existing signup and account-linking flows. Separated app and web authentication, including environment-specific OAuth and Secrets configuration in Terraform and ECS.

**DynamoDB-based global account integration.** Kept country-specific databases separate while linking accounts through shared UUIDs. Added shared-state validation to login and token refresh to resolve cross-country inconsistencies in account closure and re-registration.
**US and Australian launch support.** Integrated local tennis-court data and court-specific time zones, correcting match-date errors caused by differences between server and local time.

**Unified APIs for social and tier-based matches.** Consolidated response and processing structures while retaining legacy endpoints and reusing payment and notification logic so the existing app could coexist with the new APIs.

**Lesson development and operational improvements.** Built models and APIs for recurring schedules, applications, payments, and settlement. Used APM and SQL to diagnose slow queries and reduce repeated lookups and unnecessary joins.

companies.name: Playtag
companies.description: AI video analysis of preschool children's behavior. Built internal web applications for analysis reruns and client configuration.
highlights: **Python web tool for rerunning failed video-analysis jobs.** Replaced manual server access and code execution with a web-based selection-and-submit workflow, reducing rerun preparation from **about 1 hour to 5 minutes or less**. Built and deployed the tool.

**Client configuration moved from developer edits to operations self-service.** Enabled staff to record and apply kindergarten schedules and settings through a web interface, reducing handoffs and manual code changes. Ran the tool on a low-cost single instance suited to internal usage.
**Kotlin · Spring Boot APIs for kindergarten student management.** Built the complete set of new APIs **within a one-week sprint**, applying both technologies in production for the first time.

companies.name: Artue.io
companies.description: Art commerce and online exhibition platform. Worked on media processing, AWS infrastructure, and API migration for a running service.
highlights: **Asynchronous media processing with Python · Serverless Framework · S3/Lambda.** Generated display-specific WebP images and multiple video resolutions after upload. Used in-memory streams and filtered derived-file events to eliminate temporary-file handling and duplicate conversions.

**Terraform · AWS EC2/ECS infrastructure and Auto Scaling configuration.** Changed instances from **t3.medium to t3.small** and the CPU scaling target from **40% to 20%**, consolidating environment-specific capacity settings.

**Gradual API and TypeORM migration.** Migrated customer, artwork, and purchasing functionality while **running v2 and v3 APIs in parallel**. Added tests and enabled feature-by-feature frontend adoption to limit the impact on the existing web service.

**Multi-currency purchasing and payment integration.** Applied exchange rates, discounts, and shipping costs across carts, orders, and payments for currencies including EUR and THB. Integrated Naver Pay, supported its approval process, and restored coupons on cancellation.

companies.name: Viewee Inc.
companies.description: Services connecting user-contributed data, AI analysis, and blockchain rewards. Developed data validation automation and transaction APIs.
highlights: **Automated manual image-annotation review.** Combined bounding-box and OCR cross-checks with text-similarity validation and scheduled recurring checks in Airflow.
**EarnTube token transaction APIs.** Built TypeScript/NestJS APIs and history models to track transaction results and hashes, and migrated legacy points history.

companies.role: Co-planning, app and backend development, and deployment
companies.name: re:feel
companies.description: AI journaling app offering diary analysis and illustrations. Co-planned with a friend; personally developed and deployed the app and backend.
highlights: **AI journaling app built with Django/DRF · MySQL · React/Capacitor.** Co-planned the product with a friend, personally developed the app and backend, and handled AWS deployment, **launching on iOS and Android in about two months**.

**Connected AI analysis, illustrations, and in-app purchases to the product experience.** Implemented asynchronous result retrieval, translation, server-side purchase validation, and access entitlements.

**Product improvements guided by Firebase data and user feedback.** Shifted focus to Korean users and combined feature improvements with social media promotion; **cumulative signups grew from about 10 to over 100 within weeks**.
